messages:
farah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  a few concise asks from AE/partnerships about pipeline and partner pilot terms.
farah: Main questions: 1) How should AEs classify inbound trials in SFDC (POC vs Opp)? 2) What exactly is the partner co-sell pilot (credits, timing, regs)? 3) Where do we point AEs for Hosted -> Dedicated guidance?
noah: Classification: inbound trials = POC until there's a signed PO or active subscription. POCs should NOT be included in commit. Add an expected-close field for tracking.
ivy: Partner pilot: registered partners only; 10% co-sell credit for Q2 pilot; credits applied at invoicing, no retroactive credits. Registration via the partner form in #partners -> https://redwood.co/partners/register
pete: Sales Ops will own the co-sell calc and add a tab to the quote template. Finance will reconcile monthly for auditing.
leena: Hosted first for fastest TTV. Recommend Dedicated when a customer needs data residency, guaranteed throughput, or pinned model variants. Product will publish a one-pager and decision tree.
noah: SE request: can we get a short migration runbook and a sample terraform snippet? SEs need expected lead times (typical 3-10 business days), network/KMS checklist, and rollback guidance.
ivy: Will publish SE handoff doc with terraform example and a checklist. Linking draft -> https://git.redwood.co/infra/dedicated-handoff
growth-bot: Recording + slides uploaded -> https://redwood.co/all-hands/1839990011
farah: Action items recap: 1) Ivy: publish partner pilot doc + SE handoff; 2) Pete/Sales Ops: add calc to quote template; 3) Product: Hosted vs Dedicated one-pager; 4) Noah: set up partner office hours next Wed. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
sales-ops: :white_check_mark: calc tab added to quote template and shared in #sales.
ivy: :white_check_mark: partner pilot doc + SE handoff posted.
noah: :white_check_mark: office hours scheduled (Wed 11am PT) and calendar invite sent.
farah: Thanks everyone  closing thread. Ping me if you want help on customer handoffs. :v:
